Base: crates.io pagefind 1.5.2. Source and embedded assets are copied from
the published crate, not from a moving Git branch. License: MIT; LICENSE
is from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pagefind/pagefind/v1.5.2/LICENSE.

Local extension: PagefindIndex::add_html_files accepts an ordered batch of
unique explicit URLs for an empty index and a positive worker count.
SearchState::fossick_batch parses with a private bounded Rayon pool,
retains input order, and commits only if every page parses successfully.
The existing single-page and directory APIs are unchanged.

PagefindIndex::get_files_cached additionally compresses independent output
chunks using a private bounded pool and a caller-provided CompressionCache.
It preserves the original gzip encoding and common files. The caller must
verify cache payload integrity. Global index packing remains unchanged;
unchanged fragments and chunks can reuse their compressed bytes after edits.

PagefindIndex::add_html_files_cached adds caller-owned ParseCache storage
for opaque serialized per-page FossickedData. The caller namespaces by
Pagefind version and indexing options and verifies payload integrity.
Missing or invalid payloads are reparsed. Global index assembly, page
number assignment and ordered batch commit remain unchanged. Tests compare
all output bytes after edits, deletions, URL changes, reordered inputs,
multiple languages and corrupt payloads.

Changed upstream files: src/lib.rs, src/service/api.rs, src/output/mod.rs,
src/fossick/mod.rs and src/fragments/mod.rs. The patch is
retained in batch-api.patch. Trail's search tests compare all generated
index bytes against the unmodified single-page API with 1 and 4 workers,
and cover duplicate URLs, a nonempty index and zero workers. Compression
tests compare every file against the original API across cold/warm builds,
body edits, additions, removals and multiple languages.

Remove this local copy when an upstream release provides equivalent
in-memory batching, after rerunning those tests and the full-site output
comparison. Do not replace it with directory scanning: that changes
the selected page set and parsing-error behavior.
